replication_status: exact_code_rerun: the authors' att_gt/aggte simple call re-run with did 2.5.1 gives 0.03926 (bootstrap SE 0.01847), equal to the printed coefficient at its printed precision; bootstrap SEs within simulation noise of the printed SE
published_source: published article, Marketing Science 42(6):1143-1161 (papers/mksc/mksc.2023.1437.pdf, p. 1150, Table 5 col All); aggte(type = 'simple', na.rm = TRUE) of the authors' att_gt object. Corrected Nov 2: the earlier values came from the CA-stage LaTeX (Overleaf I_hear_you_CA, Feb 2023), which predates the published tables (fields published_*_ca_latex where they differed).
notes: Table 5 col 1: All hotels. Callaway-Sant'Anna specification as published: did::att_gt(yname, tname = exp_ymfe, idname = hotel_id, gname = first_response_ymfe [0 = never], xformla = ~1, control_group = 'notyettreated', allow_unbalanced_panel = TRUE; did defaults base_period = 'varying', est_method = 'dr', multiplier bootstrap SE) on the hotel x year-month panel the authors build in r_replication_code.R (lines 96-104, 151-152); outcome rating = round(mean(exp_stars), 2) over the hotel's Expedia reviews in the month (hotel-months without reviews are absent; unbalanced panel). Panel rebuilt verbatim from rating_data.dta in 01_explore_prepare.R (row counts equal the published Observations). published_coef is the authors' CS ATT, not a TWFE; run_spec.R's TWFE/BJS on this panel are unweighted hotel-month regressions that the paper does not report. run_spec.R runs did on this panel with the relaxed size guard (csa_max_cells/csa_max_obs, Nov 1) and the same unbalanced-panel cells and not-yet-treated controls as the authors; the authors' CS calls were also re-run separately (logs/authors_csa_results.csv).
csa_guard_note: relaxed CSA size guard (CSA_MAX_CELLS=20000, CSA_MAX_OBS=4e6) as in the overnight relaxed-guard queue, Nov 1
csa_weights_note: Nov 2: the published CSA comes from R did (or staggered, whose estimates did reproduces), which weights cells by fixed cohort shares; Hull's DiD-averaging weights cells by treated-observation counts. 'did' reproduces the published number (main analysis, option B); the strict-Hull run (CSA_STRICT_HULL=1, option A) ignores this field.
